title: Atkore 2026-06-04 Form 8-K
excerpt: Atkore agreed to pay USD 50 million to settle claims by the third putative class in the PVC pipe antitrust litigation, subject to court approval, using cash on hand; management said it did not expect a material adverse effect on liquidity or leverage metrics.
summary: The SEC current report updates the litigation cash obligation beyond the two settlements recognized in fiscal Q2 and informs downside, liquidity, and invalidation analysis.
